post.summary: Self-register a mobile member and pay via Sifalo Pay (Waafi, eDahab or Premier Wallet)
post.description: No ID document / signed-terms upload -- only a photo is required. Attaches the new member to the fixed "Online" organization. Sets termsAcceptedAt to the current time (click-through acceptance, not a document). Registration is atomic with payment: amount and method are client-supplied (amount is trusted as-is, not cross-checked against the plan's price) and charged via WAAFI mobile money against payerPhone (separate from the registrant's own phone). If the charge fails the member is rolled back (soft-deleted) -- there is no half-registered, unpaid state.

payerPhone.description: Required for wallet methods: the wallet (per `method`) to charge the plan fee to -- may differ from `phone` (e.g. a family member paying on the registrant's behalf). Not used for CARD.

returnUrl.description: Optional override for where Sifalo sends the customer after the hosted checkout. Defaults to the server CARD_RETURN_URL -- the bundled verification page, which confirms the payment and shows the outcome. Sifalo appends sid; the API appends checkout_id.

amount.description: Decimal string, e.g. "24.00". Trusted as sent -- not validated against the plan's feeAmount.

method.description: Processed through Sifalo Pay. WAAFI covers ZAAD, EVC, eSAHAL, CASHPLUS and JEEB and is charged directly. CARD (Visa/Mastercard) uses hosted checkout: the member is only created after POST /mobile/payments/card/confirm verifies the payment.

201.description: Member created, payment completed, and membership card issued

202.description: method CARD: nothing has been created yet. Send the customer to checkoutUrl; when they return, call POST /mobile/payments/card/confirm with checkoutId and the sid Sifalo appended to returnUrl.

409.description: A member with this phone or email already exists (phone and email are unique among active members; email is case-insensitive). For CARD this is checked before the checkout starts; for wallets the charge is not attempted

422.description: Sifalo Pay declined the charge (insufficient balance, wrong PIN, cancelled, etc.) -- the member was not created

503.description: Sifalo Pay gateway is not configured or unreachable -- the member was not created

post.description: No campaign, no eligibility check -- any authenticated member can donate any amount at any time. Same trust rules as registration/renewal: amount is client-supplied and trusted as sent, method must be one of WAAFI, EDAHAB or PREMIER_WALLET, payerPhone may differ from the member's own phone.

post.description: Only reachable once the current membership period has actually expired -- an early renewal attempt is rejected with 409 (the same eligibility check the staff payment endpoints use). amount/method/payerPhone follow the same rules as registration: amount is trusted as sent, method must be one of WAAFI, EDAHAB or PREMIER_WALLET, payerPhone may differ from the member's own phone. On success, extends the existing card's validUntil rather than issuing a new one.

get.description: Used by the verification page to show what is being paid while it confirms, and to tell an already-completed checkout from a dead link. No auth: the id is an unguessable uuid and nothing identifying is returned -- no member, payload or result.

post.summary: Confirm a card payment and complete the registration, renewal or donation
post.description: Step 2 of a CARD payment (step 1 is register / renew / donate with method CARD). Call it when the customer returns from Sifalo hosted checkout, with the checkout_id and sid from the return URL. The API verifies the sid with Sifalo (status success, code 601). The paid amount is not compared to the checkout: Sifalo deducts fees from card payments, so it reports a lower net amount, then creates the member / records the payment or donation exactly as the wallet flow would. No auth: card registration has no member yet, so the checkout id plus a Sifalo-verified sid is the proof. Safe to repeat: a completed checkout returns its stored result, and a sid completes only one checkout.

200.description: Completed. Body carries purpose (REGISTER | RENEW | DONATE) plus that flow's normal result: member + payment + membershipCard, payment + membershipCard, or donation.

409.description: Checkout already used or in progress, or the request can no longer be completed (e.g. phone registered meanwhile -- the payment then needs a manual refund)

422.description: Payment not completed (still pending or failed at Sifalo)

503.description: Sifalo Pay gateway is not configured or unreachable
